title: mcp-defense-bench: A Layer-Aware, Framework-Mapped Benchmark for Model Context Protocol Security Proxies
description:
A vendor-neutral benchmark that measures how much of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) attack surface a defensive proxy or gateway actually covers, driving each tool through its real code. It contributes: (1) a threat–control crosswalk of 32 MCP attack vectors (24 pre-existing + 8 introduced by the 2026-07-28 protocol revision) mapped to architectural layer, STRIDE, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, the NSA MCP Security guidance, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM and Agentic Applications; (2) a matched malicious/benign development corpus, a pre-registered held-out corpus, and a 337-item benign-only corpus; (3) adapters, a runner, and a scorer; and (4) an accompanying whitepaper. Coverage is reported per protocol revision, on development and held-out fixtures side by side, with a benign-corpus false-positive rate and 95% interval, and with inter-rater agreement for the crosswalk. This deposit includes the rubric, corpus, adapters, harness, and the whitepaper (Markdown, LaTeX, and PDF).

Rubric data and the whitepaper are licensed CC-BY-4.0; the harness code is Apache-2.0.
